section.label: Creative Lab
section.title: The Lab
section.introText: A working directory of music, visual studies, and small coding experiments. Things made for curiosity, not for outcome.

experiments.label: Music · Suno AI
experiments.title: AI-Assisted Composition
experiments.description: A series of tracks produced with Suno AI, used as a sandbox for thinking about authorship, structure, and the moment where a tool becomes a collaborator.

experiments.label: Music · Orchestra
experiments.title: Celtic Orchestral Sketches
experiments.description: Sketches for orchestral pieces with Celtic influences. An ongoing study of arrangement, motif development, and instrumental balance.

experiments.label: Visual · Album
experiments.title: Cover Experiments
experiments.description: Covers produced alongside the music — testing whether a single image can carry the same weight as a track.

experiments.label: Code · Creative
experiments.title: Generative Systems
experiments.description: Small creative coding pieces exploring rule-based composition, typography as data, and grids as instruments.

experiments.label: Interface · Exp.
experiments.title: Experimental Interfaces
experiments.description: Interface prototypes built without a brief — testing how much of an interface can be stripped before meaning collapses.
